name: wasteland
label: Haunted Wasteland
about: Pieces and textures cut from Haunted Wasteland (spot13). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where the Wasteland draws them). `sand` (`_b`, `_c`, `sand_dark`) are the rippled dunes (sand footsteps), `quicksand` the translucent flowing sand of the river, `cliff` the rock in the east, `sandstone` the striated walls by the fortress (its stripes run along v, so the scene turns it sideways). The guide's stone hut is `hut_stone_b` and `stone_sand_b`/`_c` (stone sinking into sand), with `slab`, `plinth` and `inscription` on its top; its cellar (room 0) is `hut_stone`, `cellar_floor` and `bars`. The footbridge is `deck`, `post_wood` and `plank_end`. `brick`, `stone_brick`, `beam`, `railing` and `ground` are the fortress's walls and gate as seen from outside.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: hw_guide_hut
pieces.label: Stone hut
pieces.about: The squat octagonal stone hut in the middle of the Wasteland, where the Poe guide waits on its roof by the inscribed plinth; sand drifts against its foot. Its cellar (room 0, through the hole in its north side) is left out. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: hw_footbridge
pieces.label: Wooden footbridge
pieces.about: The plank walkway on posts across a gully by the sand pit, sloping 20 from end to end, planks colliding as wood and its sandy landing as sand. The posts' feet (in the gully) don't collide. Locked.
